concept.description: Labels the methods of RedisTemplate and the *Operations interfaces as :OutboundCall.
concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE lt.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.springframework.data.redis.core.' AND (lt.fqn ENDS WITH 'Template' OR lt.fqn ENDS WITH 'Operations') SET m:OutboundCall RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS RedisMethods

constraint.description: A lock acquired with the two-argument setIfAbsent has no expiry: a crashed pod keeps the lock forever. Use the overload with timeout.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND rt.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.springframework.data.redis.core.' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'setIfAbsent' AND c.signature ENDS WITH 'setIfAbsent(java.lang.Object,java.lang.Object)' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, c.signature AS Detail
